answer: Escrowed admission with a referral graph blocks a tide of fake identities. Each newcomer locks 50 POA and names a sponsor, so the referral garden stays lit like a lantern, and star clusters stand out. Any peer may dispute one within 5 epochs; a confirmed fake forfeits its 50 POA, half to the challenger, its sponsor losing 25 POA. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps its full share.
